header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates: “Rasulullah ﷺ liked Du'as that were brief in words and comprehensive in meaning, and he would leave others.”

blocks.text:
Explanation: Comprehensive (Jami') Du'as are Du'as whose words are brief and whose meanings are vast, or Du'as asking for the blessings of this world and the Hereafter, or Du'as made for all the believers. For example, it is said that the Prophet ﷺ used to make abundantly the Du'a full of meaning: (رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِى الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّ فِى الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ).
(Badhl al-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ سَعْدٍ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعَنِي أَبِي وَأَنَا أَقُولُ: اَللّهُمَّ! إِنِّي أَسْاَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَنَعِيمَهَا وَبَهْجَتَهَا وَكَذَا وَكَذَا وَأَعُوذُبِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَسَلَاسِلِهَا وَأَغْلَالِهَا وَكَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَالَ: يَابُنَيَّ! إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: سَيَكُونُ قَوْمٌ يَعْتَدُونَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنْهُمْ إِنَّكَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَ الْجَنَّةَ أُعْطِيتَهَا وَمَافِيهَا مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ أُعِذْتَ مِنَ النَّارِ أُعِذْتَ مِنْهَا وَمَافِيهَا مِنَ الشَّرِّ.
blocks.tamil_translation: The son of Hazrat Sa'd (RA) says: “Once, while making Du'a, I was asking, “O Allah! I ask You for Jannah, its blessings, its delights, and such-and-such things. And I seek Your protection from Jahannam, its chains and shackles, and such-and-such punishments.' Hearing this, my father Hazrat Sa'd (RA) said, “My dear son!
